digest.component_or_area: Rebar LLM Agent run accounting and Pydantic boundary
propositions: Successful multi-attempt Agent runs must report aggregate usage (sum of all attempts) in a single durable JSONL row without per-attempt rows or fictional usage fields.

Terminal validation exhaustion must re-raise the identical original Rebar StructuredOutputError object by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain; terminal truncation/concision exhaustion without a Rebar cause must construct a fresh UnretryableOutputError fallback.

Failure diagnostics must preserve consumed request and token counts without creating fictional usage for calls that reported none, and terminal failure artifacts must contain the complete final provider response when artifact capture is enabled.

Existing usage schema must contain no new competing request-budget field (no candidate_requests or similar) and remain byte-compatible with historical pricing rows apart from higher counters after successful retry.
